# Production Data & Test Leftovers Audit

## 1. ID Namespace Isolation Strategy

The application enforces strict namespace separation for IDs across database records:

* **Development Seed Data**: Fixed UUID prefixes (`e1000000-%` for users, `e2000000-%` for UMKMs, `e3000000-%` for products, `e4000000-%` for media).
* **E2E & Unit Test Fixtures**: Dynamic random UUIDs generated during test execution, automatically cleaned up upon test suite tear-down.
* **Production User Data**: Standard random UUID v4 generated by PostgreSQL / Drizzle ORM.

---

## 2. Test Fixture Pollution Check

* **E2E Cleanup Verification**: Playwright test suites utilize isolated database helpers (`scripts/run-isolated.mjs`) that operate on dedicated temporary test databases. Real production or shared development databases are never modified by automated test runs.
* **Disposable DB Safety Guard**: `scripts/test-disposable-db-safety.mjs` verifies that test execution aborts immediately if the database URL points to non-local or non-test databases (such as `*.aivencloud.com`).

---

## 3. Leftover Data Audit Table

| Record Type | Marker / ID Pattern | Target Database | Status | Recommended Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Seed Admin Users | `admin1@local.test` | Dev / Test | `DEV-ONLY` | Retain in dev/test; do not deploy to production. |
| Seed UMKMs | `e2000000-%` | Dev / Test | `DEV-ONLY` | Retain in dev/test; do not deploy to production. |
| Seed Products | `e3000000-%` | Dev / Test | `DEV-ONLY` | Retain in dev/test; do not deploy to production. |
| E2E Test Events | `test-*` / dynamic UUIDs | Isolated Test DB | `CLEAN` | Automatically destroyed when isolated DB container terminates. |
